title: Bloomsbury Auction
content: On Wednesday, December 9, Bloomsbury Auction house will have a sale called "Capture the Imagination: Original Illustration and Fine Illustrated Books."There will be one Dinotopia item in the sale, a rare first edition/first printing with an even more rare title page:Bloomsbury "Capture the Imagination" Auction Catalog, Lot 279, p. 116.WebsiteBloomsbury Auctions.com
